topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: I can't believe it, you're really going. It feels like everything's changing too fast, you know? But hey, even if you're moving across the country, it doesn’t mean we’ll just... fade out, right? We’ve been through thick and thin, laughed until our bellies hurt, and supported each other through the craziest stuff. This is just another chapter in our story. We’ll make it work, I promise. I’ll come visit, and you’ll come back, and we’ll find new ways to make this distance feel small. It’s not a goodbye; it’s just a pause. Maybe this move is the adventurous chapter you needed. I’m here cheering you on, every step of the way. Keep me updated on everything, okay?
